title: Reporting an Unlocked Cash Drawer
paragraphs: Closing the shop alone one night, Bahar notices that the previous cashier forgot to lock the cash drawer properly, leaving it slightly open with a noticeable amount of money still inside.
Nobody else is around, and it would be simple to just close it quietly without mentioning the oversight to the shop owner, who would likely never find out about the mistake.
Instead, Bahar takes a photo of the drawer, locks it properly himself, and sends the owner a message that same night explaining exactly what he found and when.
The owner thanks him the next morning, mentioning that this kind of quiet honesty, especially when nobody was watching, is exactly why he trusts Bahar with closing duties each week.
